headline: Six classics go reportable — the arcade now sees every run
lede: Batch 11 of the seedpin rollout wired production run-reports into Galaga, Ice Climber, Polarity, Dogfight, Zelda and Super Mario Classic. An audit proved these engines were already deterministic — the flagged randomness was starfields, sparks and camera shake — so they report honestly seedless instead of faking a seed.

notes.text: Six more titles file {tick,score,done,…} reports: QA bots, replays and the RL rigs can now pinpoint any Galaga, Ice Climber, Polarity, Dogfight, Zelda or Mario Classic run.

Audit correction: the 'gameplay randomness' flagged in those classics was decoration — fixed wave tables and scripted patrols drive the sims. Seeding decoration would promise a replay that means nothing, so these titles report seedless.

New DECO law: every unseeded random line must match the title's audited decoration pattern (starfield, blast jitter, shake) and zero randomness may cross into the sim files — future gameplay RNG in these engines goes RED in CI.
feedbackcheck 205→217 laws, three mutants proven RED→GREEN; the arcade stands at 40 report+pin titles + 18 seedless reporters.
